title: Field3 Real Log Columns
objective: Regenerate the two real-embedding logarithm components for the exact field3 301-column principal-generator owner at 153088 bits, prove packed equality against pristine PARI 2.17.4 with independent provenance checks, and retain a bounded fail-atomic owner

oracles: exact prepared-basis and principal-generator provenance identities

handoff.summary: Regenerated a deterministic 28-column raw real-log prefix at the authentic retry boundary: all 26 scalar columns plus two nonscalar columns, both real places, 56 packed triples exactly equal to pristine PARI. Preserved the observed 153088/153152/153216 precision corridor, proved all 301 exact principal-generator norms against relation packet norms, and retained the translated output as a hash-named read-only capsule for later 3x301 assembly.
risks: The resource-bounded receipt covers 28 of 301 columns; the measured linear estimate for all real columns is about 63.5 minutes.
The third weighted complex component remains absent, so the raw 3x301 owner and its 301x13 transform cannot yet be assembled.
The complete native suite was not rerun in this lane; the focused six-minute replay and strict Python suite passed.
next_steps: Generalize the bounded entry point from prefix count to deterministic start/count batches and run the remaining 273 columns in sub-ten-minute chunks under the same owner contract.
Regenerate the weighted complex component in identical source order, then join all three raw places before applying the retained 301x13 transform.
Run the broader native suite in the integration lane after cherry-picking.
